description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mausoleum Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Mausoleum Guard dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Mausoleum Guard trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mausoleum Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
